title: Practice: platform access as configuration, graded by tests (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the policy allows invoking one model in one region and nothing else
cases.says: The policy has one statement that allows an invoke action on the one model in the one region

cases.id: e1 no action is a wildcard and every action is an invoke action
cases.says: No action is a wildcard and every action is an invoke action, so nothing else is allowed

cases.id: e2 every resource arn names one documented region and one model
cases.says: Every resource is a Bedrock model ARN with a documented region and no wildcard

cases.id: e3 every statement allows and the policy uses the current version
cases.says: Every statement allows, and the policy uses the current version

cases.id: e4 the vertex role is a custom role that can only predict
cases.says: The Vertex role is a custom role that can only predict

cases.id: e5 the vertex endpoint keeps the data where residency says and serves the model
cases.says: The Vertex endpoint keeps the data where residency says and serves the model

cases.id: e6 model ids use each platforms own form
cases.says: Model ids use each platform's own form: anthropic. on Bedrock, a Vertex id on Vertex

cases.id: e7 the quota request stays under the self service ceiling
cases.says: The quota request stays under the self-service ceiling
